description: This file defines an AuthRepository class that manages authentication-related operations such as login, logout, and retrieving the current user in a Flutter/Dart application. It interfaces with data sources, local storage, and network clients to handle authentication flows.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: A class that encapsulates authentication processes including login, logout, and fetching the cached current user.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with student ID and password, saving authentication token and user info locally.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the authentication token and user data from local storage, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user from local storage if available.
